text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Each cell: correct / questions, then percentage. All 30 routes, in overall-score order.
Darker blue = higher accuracy. Fixed 0-100% scale; random guessing = 20%.
Percentages are rounded; counts are exact. All first attempts, including failures, remain in the denominator.
